dialogue.origin: こんにちは。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: １６時になったら開始しますね
dialogue.content: We'll get started at 4:00 p.m., okay?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: なかなかお付き合いする人とうまくいかないんです
dialogue.content: I can't seem to make relationships work with the people I date.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。うまくいかないお悩みですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you're struggling with relationships not going well.

dialogue.origin: それはどういった風にうまくいかないのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about how things aren't working out?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。付き合ってもすぐに別れてしまいます。
dialogue.content: That's right. Even when we start dating, we break up very quickly.

dialogue.origin: それは寂しいですね
dialogue.content: That must be lonely.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。どうしたらいいのか？
dialogue.content: It is. I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: どのくらいの短さなのですか？
dialogue.content: How short are we talking about?

dialogue.origin: 早ければ1週間くらいです。長くても2ヶ月くらいです。
dialogue.content: As little as about a week. At most, around two months.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・お辛いですね。どちらから別れ話になることが多いですか？
dialogue.content: I see... that must be hard. Who usually initiates the breakup?

dialogue.origin: 相手からです。
dialogue.content: It's usually the other person.

dialogue.origin: だけど、何も言ってくれないんですよね
dialogue.content: But they don't say anything about why.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。辛い経験ばかり重ねておられるんですね
dialogue.content: I see. You've been having one painful experience after another.

dialogue.origin: 何か言って欲しいですよね・・
dialogue.content: You'd want them to say something, wouldn't you...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。せめて何か言ってくれると気が楽なんですけど…
dialogue.content: Exactly. If they at least said something, I'd feel a bit better...

dialogue.origin: ええ、せめて何か言ってもらえたら次は・・て思いますものね
dialogue.content: Yes, if they at least told you something, you could think about what to do next time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。何も言ってくれないです
dialogue.content: That's right. They don't say anything.

dialogue.origin: 短くて１週間って何にも分からない二人ですよね・・
dialogue.content: A week is such a short time; you barely know each other at that point, do you?

dialogue.origin: お互い知らないことばかりですよ
dialogue.content: There's so much we don't know about each other.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: That's true!

dialogue.origin: 何が悪いのかよくわからなくて
dialogue.content: I don't really know what I'm doing wrong.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: あなたから聞いてみた事は？
dialogue.content: Have you ever tried asking them?

dialogue.origin: あります。返事はそっけないですね
dialogue.content: I have. Their replies are curt.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！傷つきますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be hurtful.

dialogue.origin: 何か言葉がないと・・
dialogue.content: Without any words from them...

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、そっけないとは、、どんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, when you say 'curt,' what does that look like?

dialogue.origin: 傷つくというか、
dialogue.content: It's not so much that it's hurtful, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと不満はいってほしいです
dialogue.content: I want them to tell me what they're unhappy about.

dialogue.origin: だいたい別にとか、はぐらかされる感じです
dialogue.content: They usually say something like, 'It's nothing in particular,' and just brush me off.

dialogue.origin: はぐらかされるんですか・・。出来る事なら聞かないで欲しいみたいな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: They brush it off... Does it feel like they'd rather you didn't ask?

dialogue.origin: 何がいけなかったか教えて？ときいても、特にないよとか言われるんです
dialogue.content: Even when I ask, 'Can you tell me what I did wrong?', they say things like, 'Nothing in particular.'

dialogue.origin: じゃあなんで別れるの？って感じです
dialogue.content: Then I'm like, 'So why are we breaking up?'

dialogue.origin: それをきくと、なんかね…
dialogue.content: When I ask that, they go, 'Well, you know...'

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: とごまかす感じです
dialogue.content: They just gloss over it.

dialogue.origin: 特にないよと言われて、どんな感情になりますか？
dialogue.content: When they say 'nothing in particular,' how does that make you feel?

dialogue.origin: はぁ？って思いました
dialogue.content: I thought, 'Huh?'

dialogue.origin: なにそれ！って。
dialogue.content: Like, 'What's that supposed to mean?!'

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！怒りはありますか？
dialogue.content: That's understandable! Do you feel angry?

dialogue.origin: 少し怒りたい気持ちでした
dialogue.content: I felt a little bit like getting angry.

dialogue.origin: でも、日も浅いし印象悪くなっても嫌なので
dialogue.content: But since it was still early on, I didn't want to make a bad impression.

dialogue.origin: 少しはあったけど、のこりの気持ちは・
dialogue.content: So you felt a little angry, but the rest of your feelings were...

dialogue.origin: 何も言えませんでした
dialogue.content: I couldn't say anything.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。辛い経験されておられるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You've had some painful experiences.

dialogue.origin: 辛いというか…
dialogue.content: It's not so much painful as...

dialogue.origin: なんで？という感じです
dialogue.content: It's more like, 'Why?'

dialogue.origin: なんで？どうして？何が？ですよね！
dialogue.content: 'Why? How come? What was it?' Right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 辛いところまでいってないという事ですか？
dialogue.content: Does that mean it hasn't reached the point of being painful?

dialogue.origin: 始まったばかりで
dialogue.content: Since it had just started.

dialogue.origin: 放心状態といいますか
dialogue.content: It's like being in a daze, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: 呆気にとられる感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like I'm just taken aback.

dialogue.origin: 嫌じゃないならどうして別れるのですか？
dialogue.content: If they don't dislike me, then why do they break up with me?

dialogue.origin: ええ・・あなたに原因があるように思えないですよね
dialogue.content: Yes... it doesn't seem like the cause is with you, does it?

dialogue.origin: 私に原因がなかったらどこにあると思いますか？
dialogue.content: If the cause isn't with me, where do you think it lies?

dialogue.origin: 相手の方が移り気なタイプだったり
dialogue.content: Perhaps the other person is fickle,

dialogue.origin: 違うかったと思ったり
dialogue.content: or they felt it wasn't the right fit,

dialogue.origin: もっと好みの女性が現れてなどあるのかと思われますよね
dialogue.content: or you might think that maybe someone more their type appeared.

dialogue.origin: よくわからないです。そこまで長くお付き合いしていたわけではないので。
dialogue.content: I don't really know. We weren't dating for that long.

dialogue.origin: もし好みの方ができたなら、そう言ってほしかったです。
dialogue.content: If they found someone they liked more, I wish they'd just say so.

dialogue.origin: ええ、相手の考えてる事は長く付き合わないと分からないです
dialogue.content: Yes, you can't know what the other person is thinking unless you've been together for a long time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。こちらとしては言って欲しいですよね
dialogue.content: That's right. You'd want them to tell you.

dialogue.origin: 自分の何がいけなかったか教えてほしかったです。
dialogue.content: I wanted them to tell me what was wrong with me.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。ちなみに質問なのですが
dialogue.content: I see. By the way, may I ask a question?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Sure.

dialogue.origin: これまで何人の方とそのような短かいお付き合いされましたか？
dialogue.content: How many people have you had such short relationships with so far?

dialogue.origin: 3人です
dialogue.content: Three people.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、３人で、長くて２か月なのですよね
dialogue.content: I see—three people, and the longest was two months, correct?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんとしたお付き合いをした方は3人です。
dialogue.content: I've had proper relationships with three people.

dialogue.origin: ええ。ちゃんとお付き合いしたのが３人で、ちゃんとじゃない人もあるってことですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So there were three proper relationships—does that mean there were also others that weren't quite relationships?

dialogue.origin: lineとか交換したけど、最初は話してたけど連絡こないとかはあります
dialogue.content: There have been cases where we exchanged LINE, talked at first, and then they stopped contacting me.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。ラインとかだとホントにあなたの事を理解されてて分かれた訳ではなさそうですね
dialogue.content: I see. If it was just over LINE, it doesn't seem like they really understood you before breaking things off.

dialogue.origin: どうなんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I wonder about that.

dialogue.origin: 相手の事は理解されましたか？
dialogue.content: Do you feel you understood them?

dialogue.origin: 理解というのはどういうことですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'understand'?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ラインで話しただけならばお付き合いじゃないって事ですよね？お互いの事を、好きなこととか、色々お話されて理解する事です。
dialogue.content: Well, if you only talked on LINE, that's not really dating, is it? It's about talking about various things, like your interests, and getting to understand each other.

dialogue.origin: lineで話しているだけだとお付き合いではないんですか？
dialogue.content: Just talking on LINE isn't considered dating?

dialogue.origin: line交換するときに一応付き合わないみたいなこと言われて交換したんです。
dialogue.content: When we exchanged LINE contacts, we did so based on them asking me to date them.

dialogue.origin: ライン交換する前は出逢われたことは？
dialogue.content: Did you meet in person before exchanging LINE contacts?

dialogue.origin: どういうことですか？line交換する前のやりとりということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean? Do you mean our interactions before exchanging LINE contacts?

dialogue.origin: すみません。聞き方がわるいですね。ラインで知り合って、いきなりお付き合いしましょうって言われたのですか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I phrased that poorly. Did you meet on LINE and they suddenly asked you to date them?

dialogue.origin: lineで知りあったわけではありません。
dialogue.content: We didn't meet on LINE.

dialogue.origin: 出逢われたことのあるお方なのですね
dialogue.content: So you had met them in person.

dialogue.origin: 初めてお会いしました。
dialogue.content: It was the first time we met.

dialogue.origin: 友人の紹介です
dialogue.content: It was through a friend's introduction.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。ラインで話してもっと出逢ってしたいのに、出来ないって事ですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you talk on LINE and want to meet more, but you can't?

dialogue.origin: ラインすら続かない・・
dialogue.content: You can't even keep the LINE conversations going...

dialogue.origin: 数日はお話してましたよ。lineとか電話したりしてました。
dialogue.content: We did talk for a few days—on LINE and by phone.

dialogue.origin: 楽しかったですか？
dialogue.content: Did you enjoy those conversations?

dialogue.origin: 話しているときは楽しいですよ。
dialogue.content: I enjoy it while we're talking.

dialogue.origin: それなのに！！なぜ？ですよね！
dialogue.content: And yet!! It makes you wonder why, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どうしてなんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I wonder why that is.

dialogue.origin: ２か月の彼の時はどれぐらいの頻度でデート出来てたのでしょう
dialogue.content: In the two-month relationship, how often were you able to go on dates?

dialogue.origin: そんなにデートするほど長くないので、ほとんどお会いしていません。
dialogue.content: It wasn't long enough to go on many dates, so we hardly met in person.

dialogue.origin: お互いに仕事もあるので、lineや電話がほとんどです。
dialogue.content: We both have work, so it was mostly over LINE or phone calls.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。。いっそお付き合いしようと言わないでお友達としていたかったですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... Maybe it would have been better to have just stayed friends instead of starting to date.

dialogue.origin: お友達がほしかったわけではないので。お付き合いする人がいいです
dialogue.content: It's not that I wanted a friend. I want someone to date.

dialogue.origin: いつも相手からお付き合いしょうと言ってこられるんですか？
dialogue.content: Is it usually the other person who asks to start dating?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: That makes sense!

dialogue.origin: だいたい相手から声はかけてきてくれます
dialogue.content: Usually, they are the ones who approach me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！お付き合いしたいならお友達からと言って相手が本当にあなたに興味があるかないかを見さざめて欲しいですね。
dialogue.content: I see! If you want a relationship, perhaps you could suggest starting as friends to see if the other person is truly interested in you.

dialogue.origin: どういうことですか？相手から興味があると言ってもらう？ということですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean? Do you mean I should get them to say they're interested in me?

dialogue.origin: 付き合いましょう。とお互い合意の上でお話していたつもりでした。
dialogue.content: I thought we were talking based on a mutual agreement of "Let's be in a relationship."

dialogue.origin: それではダメなんですか？
dialogue.content: Is that not okay?

dialogue.origin: いえ、ダメではないですよ。ただあなたが付き合ってすぐ分かれて、理由をいってもらえなくても平気なら。
dialogue.content: No, it's not that it's wrong. It's fine, if you're okay with dating and then quickly breaking up without being given a reason.

dialogue.origin: 平気でしたら相談しないと思います
dialogue.content: If I were okay with it, I don't think I would be here for counseling.

dialogue.origin: ええ。今はお友達でお願いしますと言っても、あなたの事を本当に好きになってくれる方がきっと現れて、長くあなたのそばに居てくれると思いますよ
dialogue.content: Right. Even if you say, "Let's just be friends for now," I believe someone who truly comes to like you will appear and stay by your side for a long time.

dialogue.origin: お友達でお願いします。と言ってからじゃないと付き合えないんですかね？
dialogue.content: Do you mean I can't date someone unless I first say, "Let's just be friends"?

dialogue.origin: すいません。ちょっとおっしゃっていることがよくわからないです。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. I don't quite understand what you're saying.

dialogue.origin: そうではなくて、友達でもあなたのそばに居てくれる人が、あなたを長く大事にしてくれる人だと。あなたからお付き合いしましょって言うのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's not what I mean. I'm saying that the person who will stay by your side even as a friend is the person who will cherish you for a long time. What if you were the one to suggest starting a relationship?

dialogue.origin: それは自分の友達のことですか？
dialogue.content: Are you talking about my existing friends?

dialogue.origin: ええ、男性でお付き合いしましょうって言ってこられた人の事です。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm talking about the men who ask you out.

dialogue.origin: ですから、お付き合いしてもすぐに別れてしまうんです
dialogue.content: But that's the problem—even when we start dating, we break up right away.

dialogue.origin: まだお話したいけど、ごめんなさいね、時間すぎてしまいました
dialogue.content: I'd like to talk more, but I'm sorry, our time is up.

dialogue.origin: タイピングも時間かかって
dialogue.content: Typing also takes some time.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: すみません。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 難しい相談ですいません。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for bringing such a difficult issue. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 伝えたいことが伝えられず、もっと勉強しますね
dialogue.content: I couldn't convey what I wanted to say well—I’ll study more.

dialogue.origin: また宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ勉強になりました。
dialogue.content: This was a learning experience for me as well.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、とんでもないです。では終了ボタンをおさせてもらいますね
dialogue.content: No, not at all. I’ll go ahead and press the end button now.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 短期間の付き合いが続く理由と別れの原因
